name: Rozo Intents
description: Cross-chain crypto payments and bridging via Rozo. Send USDC/USDT across Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, BNB Chain (BSC), Polygon, Solana, and Stellar (Base and Stellar are USDC-only; Solana receives USDC only but can pay in USDT).

freeConfirmThresholdUsd.description: USD amount at or below which send-payment auto-executes silently with no confirmation prompt.

singleConfirmThresholdUsd.description: USD amount at or below which send-payment auto-executes with narration (no yes/no). Rozo charges no fee in this range.
